objective: Trace lot consumption and machine state for two machines in one area
boundary: single local batching area, no enterprise rollout

evidence.statement: Operators handwrite ingredient lot consumption during production; supervisor reconciles daily.
Two controllers are present; no current tag list, OPC UA capability audit or documented timestamp semantics.
Order plan arrives as a daily CSV file; record keeping after shift is manual.
Machines can be isolated for cleaning; release after cleaning is verbally confirmed.

constraints: No production network changes without site approval
No site access in this experiment
